title: EV charging in Sweden | VOOL
description: VOOL chargers and load management in Sweden: local partners, grants and rules, and datasheets.

sections.title: EV charging for buildings in Sweden, on the connection they already have
sections.lead: Chargers, load management and billing from one maker. Sold and installed by 3 partners in Sweden.

sections.title: Grants and rules in Sweden
paragraphs: The Swedish Environmental Protection Agency (Naturvårdsverket) runs the Ladda bilen grant for charging points for residents, employees and guests.
points: Housing associations (bostadsrättsföreningar), joint property associations and other associations can apply for chargers the association owns.
The grant covers material and labour for new charging points, including the electrical work.
Applications are open all year. New rules apply from 1 February 2026: companies must apply before installation starts.

items.title: Apartment buildings
items.text: Many chargers on the existing main fuse, with each resident paying for their own charging.

items.title: Offices and fleets
items.text: Employees pay for private charging; company cars are reported separately.

items.title: Developers
items.text: Design charging into new buildings and size the connection smaller.

items.title: Sell or install VOOL in Sweden
items.text: We are adding partners in this market.

items.a: No. Local partners sell and install. VOOL makes the hardware and software and supports the partners.
From 1 January 2027 newly installed chargers in the EU must support ISO 15118-20. The new VOOL Charger does.

sections.title: Planning charging in Sweden?
sections.lead: Send us the parking spaces and the main fuse size. We reply within one working day.
